guides.topic: What 'reglass' means for an iPhone: front and back meanings, versus full and aftermarket replacement, process, OLED, when it isn't possible, questions for a shop
guides.evidence: 'reglass for iphone meaning' 1,136 impressions at position 9.7 with 0 clicks, plus 'what is reglass iphone'; the site ranked from a three-paragraph section on the protector guide. Search results show the term is a repair-quote term, not a used-listing term.
sources: iFixit member guides: iPhone 11 Pro Max Screen Glass Replacement (128587), iPhone 12 Screen Refurbishment (138992)
iFixit editorials May and July 2019 (News/16303, News/30717)
iFixit: iPhone Screen Repair: Costs and Considerations
guides.notes: Owner instructions (2026-11-23): no statement about what HDR does or doesn't fit, no disclaimer about his experience; he has not fitted reglassed screens because there are usually better options, and it is not a policy. The page takes no side. Five iFixit glass-only guides returned 403 and were not used. No source uses the word 'reglass'; the page calls it trade shorthand. Three points rest on one forum answer and are labelled as such.

guides.topic: Where Samsung and Pixel show battery health, what the status words mean, charge-limit settings, when to replace
guides.evidence: Analogy: /tips/iphone-battery-health-80-percent has 13,847 impressions. /tips/android-battery-health was on the site's original plan.
sources: Samsung US: ANS10003632, galaxy-battery/about-battery, galaxy-battery/care-and-maintenance, ANS10002534
Samsung India and Caribbean battery status pages; Samsung UK battery protection page
guides.notes: No '80%' in the title: Google states 80% for Pixel, Samsung states no figure. Samsung's status words come from its India and Caribbean pages; the US pages give only the path. Verified by the integrating session: Google's Reduced-below-80%, 800 and 1,000 rated cycles, Pixel 9a note; Samsung's three status definitions, 32-95°F, and its unplug-at-100% line.
